scope: Independent native endpoint state/retry, completion-fenced replacement, source withdrawal and runtime fault/close correctness; partial M03 gate 4
build_profile: Cargo test profile, optimized with debuginfo; exact executables below

new_coverage: Failed endpoint retains last attempted GPU use; factory cannot overlap its charged slot
Retry delays 250/500/1000/2000/2000 ms; construction does not reset backoff, acceptance does
Output callback can read snapshots without holding registry locks; repeated acceptance and Ready/Busy changes coalesce
Source withdrawal precedes blocked/erroring drain; cancellation and renderer acknowledgment do not release source owners
Repeated withdrawal preserves acknowledgment, invalidates old guards and rejects late publication
A successful current frame restores serving after pre-use failure without changing the installed plan
Two failed reset allocations preserve authoring and retry exactly the next device lifetime
Cancellation wakes a ten-second reset retry wait and actual owners retire within the five-second test deadline
Project replacement during failed reset never resurrects old authoring; foreign completion cannot retire the new device
Close fences late time/backend recovery and startup; Time/Backend faults resolve independently in either order

owned_collision_test.claim: Native construction/name collision and exact-name recovery through the production runtime; API acceptance is not scanout or remote delivery

review_corrections: Regular tests alone missed a close/late-time recovery race; shared lifecycle now owns independent unresolved fault domains and close fences, with two additional regressions
